name: cache-timer
description: Footer countdown of the main prompt cache (yellow near expiry, red once expired); a confirm card before a prompt re-sends an expired cache at full price; writes a handoff note shortly before the cache expires, so a new session can resume from it; writes each pane's cache state for cache-state.sh

handoffLeadMinutes.title: Handoff note, minutes before the cache expires
handoffLeadMinutes.description: While a session sits idle, the model writes a handoff note this many minutes before the prompt cache expires, so a new session can resume from it. 0 turns it off. Not used on the 5-minute cache tier.

handoffMinTokens.title: Handoff only above this context size (tokens)
handoffMinTokens.description: A session whose context is smaller than this gets no handoff note: rebuilding it costs little. 0 writes one at any size.
